summary: People who attend services regularly are more likely to know and trust their neighbors.
realLife: Pew found those who attend religious services at least monthly were more likely both to know and to trust their neighbors.
sources: Pew Research Center, how connected Americans feel to neighbors (March 2025 survey): https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2025/05/08/how-connected-do-americans-feel-to-their-neighbors/
inGame: neighbor-tie count and trust value; needs: attendance as a driver of tie formation
